$comment: Single source for input limits and auth policy. Read by the frontend (src/constants/limits.ts), the web API (server/limits.js) and the desktop API (src-tauri/src/backend/limits.rs, embedded at compile time). Error texts that mention these numbers get them as params, so changing a value here updates every message.

avatar.$comment: The app accepts a photo up to sourceMaxBytes, crops it to a square, resizes it to sizePx and saves it as a lossless PNG data URL. Both backends accept only an image data URL up to maxChars (a 512px PNG is at most ~1.06 MB, ~1.42 million characters as base64, even for a photo that barely compresses).
